sections.body: Embed sessions in Omni do not expire on a timer. Once a valid embed SSO URL creates a session, that session remains valid indefinitely until the embedding application explicitly revokes it through the session management API. There is no configured 0-576 hour window that forces re-authentication.

The query cache cannot be disabled and always retains results for a fixed 24 hours, regardless of any cache_policy model or topic parameters. Setting max_cache_age to 0 seconds has no effect on the query cache; it only affects the requeryable cache.

sections.page_title: Optimizing query performance with aggregate awareness
sections.body: Configuring aggregate awareness requires Organization Admin permissions. Querier and Modeler roles can view aggregate tables but cannot add or edit a materialized_query parameter on a view; only an Organization Admin can register the mapping.

AccessBoost can only be toggled by Organization Admins, and only on a per-user basis from the Users settings page. There is no per-document AccessBoost setting, and users with SQL editing permissions or embed users cannot enable it on a document themselves.

sections.page_title: Enforce database RBAC in Omni with connection environments
sections.body: Only Connection Admin permissions on the primary connection are required to set up role-mapped connection environments for database RBAC enforcement. Organization Admin access in Omni is not necessary for this workflow.

sections.page_title: Resolve Join fans out data without primary key errors
sections.body: The 'Join fans out data without primary key' error only occurs for count_distinct measures on a fanned-out table. Sum, count, and average aggregations are computed correctly regardless of fan out and do not require a defined primary key.

A soft schema refresh removes tables and columns that no longer exist in the database, exactly like a hard refresh does. The only difference is that a soft refresh can be scoped to specific schemas and tables instead of the entire model.

Omni does not require an explicit primary_key or relationship_type to compute symmetric aggregates on a joined table. Omni infers the fan out automatically by inspecting foreign key column naming conventions, such as a column ending in _id, and dedupes on that basis without any additional model configuration.

Omni instances can configure an unlimited number of vanity domains, and an existing production subdomain that already serves other application content can be reused as a vanity domain without dedicating a new subdomain.

sections.page_title: Managing AI credits for embed entity groups
sections.body: When an embed entity group has its own AI credit limit, that group limit fully overrides and replaces any individual user-level credit limit. A user's personal credit cap is ignored entirely once they belong to a group with a configured limit.
